items.text: Since the free Extended Operations DLC came out, many of you have been playing New Game+, trying out Photo Mode and racing through the Valhalla Protocol. The reception of the update is amazing to see and looking at all the creative, funny and impressive photos across all social channels has become one of most favourite pastimes for a lot of team members here at IOI.

[p align="start"]We’ve been following your reports and feedback closely. Hotfix 1.3.2 brings more stability and polish improvements and gives the suit formerly known as “Grey Standard Suit” its own name and description. Additionally, it also includes a fix for the “Positively Shocking” achievement/trophy, which was reported by quite a few community members directly – Thank you for that!
[p align="start"]With this Game Update we are adding overall three new outfits:

[p align="start"]As some of you may have noticed, that the outfit “The Grey Standard”, which was redeemable after linking your game to an IOI Account didn’t really match the outfit you may have expected. With this update we’ve aimed to set things right: the outfit we’ve deployed has now its own name, Heritage Tailoring, and is yours to keep. The real “The Grey Standard” is also finally coming to the game and will be unlockable by every player with a little investment of Intel given you have reached Clearance Level 15. As a little teaser for an upcoming beat and also to manage patch frequency we’ve made the decision to add the Midnight Recon outfit with unlock conditions to be revealed at a later time soon.
The real “The Grey Standard” is now in the game and no longer requires an IOI Account. Unlock it for 6,000 Intel at Clearance Level 15.
This is the outfit that was previously unlocked as “The Grey Standard”. It now has its own name and description. If you already redeemed it, it will stay in your inventory.
A new outfit joining the game with this update. Details on how to unlock it will follow soon.
Fixed a rare crash that could occur during the escape drive cinematic in Chapter 04: THE PAST NEVER DIES when Path Tracing was enabled.
Fixed an issue where completing challenges in TacSim: Valhalla Protocol missions could fail to award Intel or XP.
Fixed an issue in TacSim: Valhalla Protocol where players could drive onto the rocks next to the lumber mill, potentially getting stuck or being launched into the air.
Fixed an issue in TacSim: Valhalla Protocol (Day) where players could get stuck between police cars after a high-speed jump off the ramp.

Fixed an issue where the air time needed for the Flight challenge in TacSim: Valhalla Protocol could only realistically be reached by reusing the same ramp. The challenge can now be completed in a regular run.
Fixed an issue where making an enemy taser another enemy could fail to unlock the “Positively Shocking” achievement/trophy.
Fixed an issue where Bond’s clothing could stretch or clip when rotating him in Photo Mode.
Fixed an issue where Bond’s outfit could appear stretched or distorted during the riding sequence with Greenway in New Game+ with certain outfits equipped.
Fixed an issue where Bond’s coat could hang unnaturally and jitter during the Crocodile Pit section.
[p align="start"]Thank you to everyone who has played and shared feedback with us. If you run into an issue not listed here, please contact Player Support.

With the free Extended Operations DLC, we added New Game+, Photo Mode, the "00" difficulty and the Valhalla Protocol to 007 First Light. Since the update went live, your reports and feedback have helped us find a few issues that came along with it.

This hotfix deals with some of them. It includes a crash fix, TacSim leaderboard disconnections, an outfit that wouldn't unlock, and a handful of visual and audio glitches. We wanted to get these fixes to you quickly so you can get back to your missions.
Thank you to everyone who has played and shared feedback with us.

We’ve seen your reports on performance following the 007 First Light Path Tracing update and your questions about the PC specs we disclosed. Although 007 First Light is a detailed and graphically demanding game when running with path tracing, we’re confident that players should be able to have a good experience on supported cards when using the right mix of settings.
Because of this demanding workload, 007 First Light offers the full stack of NVIDIA DLSS features to help you find the right settings and balance between image quality and performance.

In addition to last week’s hotfix addressing some GPU hangs, we’re deploying another hotfix today, which contains further improvements to visuals and performance, as well as the user experience of enabling path tracing.

Today’s hotfix includes an option to enable recommended default settings to smooth out the experience, but if you want to go ahead and do it manually we are issuing clearer guidance on configuring your settings to best enjoy path tracing on supported RTX cards.
Make sure your game and graphics drivers are up to date, then use these settings as a starting point:
(Depending on your preferences and display, toggle Options -> Graphics -> VSync -> Off)
Select the Path Tracing mode that is recommended for your card:
Set fullscreen resolution to the value recommended for your card when using path tracing:
DLSS super resolution -> Auto (DLSS Auto - mode selects automatically the best upscaling ratio for your selected fullscreen resolution)
Multi Frame Generation starts at 2X (one generated frame) up to 6X (5 generated frames), depending on your preferences
Or if you prefer, you can enable Dynamic Multi Frame Generation which will dynamically adjust the multiplier to maintain a consistent FPS.
With the recommended settings, you should expect around 60fps on RTX 5070 at 1080p resolution and around 60 fps on RTX 5080 at 1440p resolution, depending on the mission and checkpoint.
When adding 2x DLSS Frame Generation and with DLSS Super Resolution on the Auto setting, you should be able to play consistently above 60fps across the game.

5090 cards should yield even better results and can achieve frame rates of 200+ FPS when running with 6x DLSS Frame Generation values. Additionally, Dynamic Multi Frame Generation will dynamically adjust the multiplier to maintain a consistent FPS.

007 First Light currently offers both Medium and High quality settings. The High setting can produce more detailed images, thanks to using higher-quality shading and levels of detail in reflections, as well as a higher number of bounces. Because this improved accuracy is very resource-intensive, our current recommendation for the most balanced experience is to use the Medium setting unless using an RTX 5090 card.
Thank you for your passion and interest in high-end real-time rendering technology.
We look forward to your continued feedback as we bring further improvements and optimizations to path tracing in future updates to 007 First Light.

This week we shipped the long-anticipated Path Tracing update for 007 First Light. Although the positive reception to the visual improvements was a great payoff for the amount of work that went into this update, we recognize that there is room for improvement in terms of performance.

We’re aware that some players are experiencing performance issues, and we’re working closely with NVIDIA to investigate these reports, improve performance and clarify questions around settings and hardware requirements.
Today’s hotfix is the first step in addressing these issues, with further improvements planned for updates and hotfixes over the next couple of weeks.
Thank you for your patience and feedback.

items.text: Added support for AMD FSR™ Upscaling (formerly AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 4) On supported GPUs (AMD Radeon™ RX 7000 and 9000 series cards, RDNA 3 and RDNA 4 architecture) the game now automatically selects the latest AMD FSR™ Upscaling 4.1 when FSR is selected as the upscaling method in-game. On other cards we fall back to using AMD FSR™ 3.1.

[p align="start"]As a follow-up to our most recent Game Update 1.1.0 (Behind Enemy Lines) - introducing a series of new TacSim missions, unlockable outfits, and weapons - ver. 1.1.1 brings in another set of game improvements: focused on the title’s overall stability, as well as Achievement-related issues reported by you.

[p align="start"]We remain dedicated to continuously improving the experience and appreciate all of your feedback, reports, and support shared. Please find the full details of this update below and follow our social channels to stay informed about future news on 007 First Light.
Addressed an issue where the title would not launch on some PCs, resulting in a black screen followed by a client crash.
Fixed a rare issue that could cause a crash after entering the Advanced Training in Malta and pausing the game during it.

Introduced a series of backend improvements and fixes to the game’s online systems to address the achievement-related issues reported by the community. This includes improvements to the achievements' unlock logic across all platforms.
To check the current list of known issues, please refer to our dedicated Known Issues page. It also features potential workarounds that may help if you are having trouble.
[p align="start"]If you encounter an issue that is not present on our Known Issues page, please use this form to contact our Player Support Team and share the details.
[p align="start"]As always, many thanks for all your support for 007 First Light, and the feedback allowing us to further improve your experience!

[p align="justify"]First and foremost, we would like to extend our deep gratitude for such an incredibly warm reception of 007 First Light during Early Access and Launch. Your excitement is truly remarkable to witness, and we thank you for all the support.
[p align="justify"]As we continue to make further improvements, please follow our social media channels to stay up to date on all things 007 First Light.
Fixed a crash which occurred during a cutscene featuring Bond & Moneypenny after the Opening Credits (Title Sequence), at the beginning of "In His Majesty's Secret Service".
Fixed an issue in Chapter 06 “Uninvited”, where guards would immediately become hostile and skip confrontational dialogue after Bond leaves the CCTV room.
Fixed a crash which occurred after leaving M’s office in Chapter 02 “A Night Out”.
Fixed an issue where Bond standing in Greenway’s or other NPC’s way would lead to pathing issues making them disappear or go through walls.
Fixed a crash which occurred during a cutscene after the completion of Chapter 05 “Beyond the Grave”.
